description: This file contains utility functions used to generate HTML UI components such as form headers, footers, module titles, and popup headers/footers in a SugarCRM/Vtiger CRM project. It includes functions for creating styled tables with titles, integrating images, and adding help links.

methods.name: get_left_form_header
methods.description: Generates HTML for the left pane form header with a specified title.

methods.name: get_left_form_footer
methods.description: Returns HTML to close the left pane form.

methods.name: get_form_header
methods.description: Generates HTML for a form header with optional help and print links.

methods.name: get_form_footer
methods.description: Placeholder for generating form footer HTML; currently empty.

methods.name: get_module_title
methods.description: Creates HTML for displaying a module's title with optional help/print links.

methods.name: insert_popup_header
methods.description: Outputs HTML for the beginning of a popup window including theme CSS.

methods.name: insert_popup_footer
methods.description: Outputs HTML to close a popup window.
